failure: Python polling reader received PermissionError during atomic pointer replacement
resolution: Bounded polling retries transient Windows read sharing/access conflicts; native reader uses DELETE sharing.

resolution: Flat slot cleanup removes one oversized frame, but was insufficient alone. See the subsequent failure.

failure: DLL still exceeded the default MSVC 1 MiB thread stack during initial manifest publication
evidence: Optimized x86_64-windows-gnu assembly: menkh_run_job_v1 133288 bytes, job.runControlled 146440, Publisher.publish 362776, atomicBytes 267208, atomicFile 131440, sliceToPrefixedFileW 131176. These are individual frame sizes, not a measured peak or certified call-chain bound.
resolution: Native calculation worker reserves 16 MiB through _beginthreadex, matching Zig 0.15.2 thread default. Windows C whole-job stack requirement documented.
